sloka: ते तव प्रबलं दर्पमुत्सेधं च पृथग्विधम् ।व्यपनेष्यन्ति सम्भूय सहामात्यसुतस्य च ।। ७.१६.१९ ॥
transliteration: te tava prabalaṁ darpamutsedhaṁ ca pṛthagvidham ।vyapaneṣyanti sambhūya sahāmātyasutasya ca ।। 7.16.19 ॥

translations.english: They will unitedly destroy your mighty and diverse arrogance and haughtiness, along with your ministers and sons.
